SESSION DELTA — 2026-07-23 Vortex + Thermal Cascade + ACRE

Decisions locked:
- Air mass-flow is master variable, set by optimized φ-vortex chimney (H/D = φ², dc = D/φ²)
- One-person Micro-Node sizes: 10–14 m² aperture, 15–18 m chimney, 5–9 m³ wet open-cell labyrinth, 1.5–2.5 m³ hot tank, 2–3.5 m³ cold tank, 5–8 m² radiative lid
- Cold path includes desiccant + wet volumetric concrete + ground heat sink + radiative lid
- Stirling uses discrete thermal charges only (5–8 % of tank capacity) + flywheel + high-torque belt + final alternator
- TEGs only on residual ΔT
- Efficiency metric = measured useful joules (heat, cold, mechanical, electrical) only
- ACRE minting rule: only instrumented useful work from the thermodynamic ledger may mint. No theoretical numbers (including old 12.91) allowed in minting or system prompts.

Ratios locked:
- Hot : Cold tank capacity ≈ 1 : 1.0–1.2
- Stirling extraction ≤ 0.65 × weaker source
- Labyrinth volume ≈ 0.5 m³ per m² solar aperture
- Nodes are fully modular: standalone or bus-connected (hot/cold water + electrical)

Next physical actions:
1. Lock exact Micro-Node dimensions
2. Instrument first prototype (flow, ΔT hot, ΔT cold, shaft work)
3. Implement thermodynamic ledger that records only measured joules
4. Wire ledger → ACRE minting (PoPW)
